description:
Team RAVYN bridges aerospace systems engineering and interactive game design. We are building an immersive web-based simulator where players manage real-world mission trade-offs—balancing payload mass, power budgets, delta-V, and launch costs from concept to launch.

We bring together game architecture, full-stack development, orbital physics, and UI/UX design to deliver a prototype powered by real telemetry and dynamic simulation mechanics that makes mission planning intuitive.
